scope: Local business walkthroughs. Fictional visitors and businesses; no external delivery or measured conversion claims.

scenarios.name: A shopper choosing a gift
scenarios.need: A visitor is unsure what to choose, wants to understand the offer, and checks delivery before ordering.
steps: Try every product-finder route, then change an earlier answer. Check the recommendation and fallback against real sample products.
Submit the welcome form with fictional details and use the revealed DEMO10 code in the sample basket.
Check one £24 item: £2.40 discount and £4 delivery. Check two: £4.80 discount and free UK delivery above £40 after discounts.
Follow the cart reminder with a non-empty basket; empty it and confirm the reminder no longer appears.
scenarios.success: The visitor reaches a suitable available product and understands the real basket total. Capture, coupon reveal and cart navigation do not prove a purchase.

scenarios.name: A homeowner planning work
scenarios.need: A visitor wants a useful first conversation, not a falsely confirmed appointment.
steps: Choose a landscaping request, continue to contact details, go Back, and confirm the request is preserved.
Try missing details, then valid fictional details. Check that the final acknowledgement confirms only receipt of the enquiry.
In the callback form, change the phone country and select a service. Confirm canonical phone and service choice in the saved Lead.
Request the preparation guide and open the actual sample resource. The local outbox is evidence of mail handoff only.
scenarios.success: The business receives enough context to reply once, with correct contact details. No booking, quote or provider delivery is implied.

scenarios.name: A reader looking for useful advice
scenarios.need: A reader wants a relevant guide and may prefer email without text messages.
steps: Find a content recommendation and open its guide without subscribing. Test the fallback as well as a matched result.
Request the writing checklist and verify the accessible resource contains all seven promised points.
Submit email in the headlines campaign, go Back, and confirm the accepted email is protected.
Finish without SMS and reach the acknowledgement. On a separate run, add SMS and confirm the same Lead is enriched rather than duplicated.
scenarios.success: The reader gets the promised content and controls the optional channel. Subscription delivery and future engagement are outside this local trial.
